event_detail: Drawer: the empty gripper hovers at the left corner in front of a lower cabinet panel for 4.8 s, making small up/down motions, without grasping any drawer handle; drawers stay closed.
evidence: Shoulder views show the arm in nearly the same pose in all four frames at the left end of the counter, gripper pointed at the corner cabinet; the drawer fronts under the counter look closed. The wrist camera only shows a gray raised cabinet panel and a strip of wooden floor, no open drawer and no straw; the gripper is empty. A drawer outside the views cannot be fully ruled out.
